7.7.3.3 Monitor internal debounce algorithm
Monitor internal debouncing is used, if the event does not need debouncing or requires a more complex debouncing that is not covered by counter or time based debouncing. In that case the monitor reports only qualified results to the Dem and DEM_EVENT_ STATUS_PREFAILED and DEM_EVENT_STATUS_PREPASSED cannot be used (eg. Dem_SetEventStatusWithMonitorData, Dem_SetEventStatus...) in a call of Dem_SetEventStatus.
